overview: Join Chris, Pui and the toys in their magical playroom. Have fun playing games, singing songs and practising your groovy moves.
title: Show Me Show Me

overview: Celebrate summer and brighten your morning with some very special mini-episodes of Show Me Show Me. Chris, Pui and all the toys head to Scarborough where they have lots of fun at the seaside. There's the usual mix of songs, nursery rhymes and imaginative play to explore rockpools, sandcastles, ice-cream - and more.
title: Show Me Show Me Seaside

overview: A League of Their Own is heading to Mexico for their next epic adventure. As ever, it's Red vs Blue –with the teams competing in a series of sporting and cultural challenges in a bid to avoid the series forfeit. To raise the stakes, for the first time ever it won't just be the team captains in the firing line for the forfeit. In previous series, viewers have seen the gang dance as cheerleaders in front of 90,000 LA Rams fans, taken driving lessons from Max Verstappen at the Singapore Grand Prix, had a tennis match umpired by Novak Djokovic at the Monte-Carlo Masters and joined the cast of Aladdin on Broadway. This Road Trip promises to be even more exciting as the teams travel from Mexico City to Baja California – seeing all incredible Mexico has to offer. Among the adventures is taking part in the infamous Day of the Dead Parade, learning the art of Mexican Rodeo, scuba diving with sea lions in choppy waters, and wrestling each other in a Lucha Libre match. Anything for some points for the team, right?
title: A League of Their Own: Mexican Road Trip

overview: Participants come to a dark castle to fight for a cash prize. The entire team is divided into "Loyals" and "Traitors", who are selected by Malwina on the first day of the game. The main goal of the villains is to eliminate the other group and divide the reward among themselves. Every night, the Traitors meet for a joint debate to determine who from the Loyal group will be eliminated. All participants also take part in challenging missions.
title: The Traitors. Zdrajcy

overview: Secrets and dangers lie ahead for young Lyra Belacqua in an epic tale of stolen children and the mysterious substance of Dust.
title: His Dark Materials

overview: Chu Sheng followed Master Qin in the northeast to do funeral business, for all kinds of dead people. During that, there were many strange funeral anecdotes. As a professional undertaker, Chu Sheng visited the folk together with the Reporter Lin who came to explore the weird stories and experienced one after another bizarre folk stories.
title: Wo Zai Dong Bei Zuo Bai Shi De Na Xie Nian

overview: At the heigh of his career and powers, Japan's master fixer, who has guided politicians and business heads through some of Japan's biggest scandals and triumphs, must maneuver through his last and biggest fix. Meanwhile, he must come to grips with the problems that besiege his own familiy as he discovers that fixing his family is sometimes harder than fixing a country.
title: House of the Owl

overview: The cool woman has to play a maid who has always been humiliated while the gentle CEO has to pretend like he's a brutal prince. She sharpens her dagger every night, trying crazily to kill him; He teases her every day, trying desperately to win her heart. In this amusing and romantic love duel, let's see who can gain ground and complete the mission first. During the duel, they begin to realize that they're caught in a conspiracy.
title: The Love Duel

overview: A full-fledged defense romantic comedy about Shin Yoon Bok, a pupil from Seongsan village with Confucianism in his bones, and Kim Hong Do, an aggressive modern woman who only knows how to go straight.
title: Dare to Love Me

overview: Bitter Sweet Hell tells the story of Korea's best psychological counselor Young Won and her mother-in-law Sa Gang facing each other's secrets and truths due to their husband and son.
title: Bitter Sweet Hell

overview: So Jin, a genetic researcher who loves DNA, decides to end her relationship with a playboy boyfriend and sets out to find a genetically compatible partner for a happy relationship. Whom among the two men that So Jin meets, obstetrician-gynecologist Yeon Woo and firefighter Kang Hoon, will be the perfect match for her? A captivating story intertwined with genetics! This story portrays the struggles, love, and everyday lives of young friends.
title: DNA Lover

overview: An employee of the newspaper American Post Alex Wilson sent a long term business trip to Russia, where he will not only have a wonderful day to explore the Russian reality, but also gradually to comprehend the mysterious Russian soul. In addition to drafting tasks, Alex starts a personal blog, where every day will try to answer the question of "what it means to be Russian?"
title: Как я стал русским

overview: Kojima Toru is a medical school student, but he is bored with his life that always seems the same. One day, he meets an architect, Asano Shifumi, and he is invited to her office. He enjoys a pleasant time with her. They drink coffee and listen to music. At that time, he sees a black and white photo of the Tokyo Tower on her office wall. He asks her if she likes the Tokyo Tower, and she replies that she does not because it looks lonely to her. Kojima Toru loves the time he spends with her. A couple of days later, he visits her office again and tells her that he wants to know more about her.
title: Tokyo Tower

overview: When the daughter of a prosperous family decides to marry, it's her harried father, who ends up suffering most.
title: Father of the Bride

overview: The Express Way with Dulé Hill is a premium documentary series that transcends geographical boundaries, providing viewers with an intimate look into the lives of artists across America. Each episode serves as a bridge, connecting diverse backgrounds and celebrating the universal power of the arts to illuminate the human experience. The journey begins in California, a state synonymous with dreams, where Dulé uncovers a narrative beyond the surface.
title: The Express Way with Dulé Hill

overview: One mistake of youth - and years of attempts to correct it. Since childhood, Vlada has been inconvenient for those around her: difficult, distrustful, aggressive. Having stumbled once, the girl has served her sentence and wants to start a new life. Max helps her in this, having already gone through hell in New Girl. But the past again pulls Vlada to the bottom. And this time, on the path to freedom, you need to overcome not only yourself.
title: Трудная

overview: Set in London's beating heart of music "Camden" reveals the untold stories of how the lives and careers of some of the world's most iconic artists were influenced by this corner of London. Through archive footage, observational filming and interviews, we will explore Camden's rich history. Hearing from world renowned musicians as they relive their Camden experiences; from their very first gigs to sell out concerts, the highs and lows of nights out and a youth spent discovering music.
title: Camden

overview: Helen Czerski uncovers what colour is, how it works and how it has written the story of our planet. She seeks out the colours that turned the Earth multicoloured.
title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science

overview: Mastermind: To Think Like a Killer, a fascinating new perspective on the woman whose crime hunting innovations changed history. To stop serial killers, psychiatric nurse and professor Dr. Ann Burgess must first learn to think like one. With unprecedented access to the mastermind behind the development of modern serial-killer profiling, the series tells Burgess' tenacious story and her compassion for victims which puts her at the center of America's most infamous true-crime cases. From the widely known Ed Kemper and Ted Bundy to lesser-known cases like the Ski Mask Rapist, Burgess investigates and studies the damaged psyches of victims and their attackers, putting two halves of the same story together to catch a killer. Largely an unsung heroine until now, Dr. Burgess impacted not only the FBI, she also radically championed the plight of women in America.
title: Mastermind: To Think Like a Killer

overview: Following the on-the-water lifestyle, including fishing, travel, food, cruising, diving and other activities as seen through the eyes of Capt. Brandon Simmons.
title: Life on the Water

overview: Real Sex explores human sexuality, from the latest sexual fads to casual sex festivals and home production of pornographic movies. The show typically explores three to four topics each episode. Segments are separated by street interviews with random people, relating to the episode's topics.
title: Real Sex

overview: In the sensational project "Miracle People," the famous Safronov brothers defy the laws of physics and nature to amaze viewers with incredible and dangerous stunts performed to the limit of human capabilities.
title: Чудо-люди

overview: Famous guests come to the studio with their kind and sweet pets and talk about what surprises their four-legged and feathered family members give them every day. Viewers can expect exclusive video reports and advice from experts - groomers, zoologists, hippotherapists, dog trainers, animal psychologists, lawyers and even animal fashion experts. Also, TV viewers will have the opportunity to shelter a pet left without an owner.
title: В кругу друзей

overview: Roman Mysteries is a tremendous way for younger viewers to learn about ancient history. Set in the Roman Empire in AD79, it is based on a series of novels by Caroline Lawrence that have sold more than a million copies worldwide. It isn't hard to see why - they graft child-friendly adventure on to careful research, and the same care has been taken to transfer them faithfully to the screen with the help of a strong cast and healthy-looking budget. The first episode this afternoon gives a vivid sense of gladiatorial combat, without the risk of children waking up in the middle of the night screaming.
title: Roman Mysteries

overview: Tawan Chai rushes back to Thailand from England after hearing that his grandfather and uncle have passed away in an accident. Tawan Chai believes he is the only living heir to his family fortune. After his uncle and grandfather's funeral and the reading of the will, however, Tawan Chai is surprised to discover that he is not the only heir and he might have to share his inheritance with Torfun, who is believed to be a long lost grandchild. Torfun is a street smart young woman with a heart of gold who needs the money to support her family and pay hers and her little brother's school tutitions. Tawan Chai is not too happy about Torfun and her family moving into his mansion and even though they try to act like cousins, destiny just won't let them...
title: Bpom Ruk Roy Adeed

overview: The story of Pitawan (Usamanee Vaithayanon), a young woman under the guardianship of Inthanil (Duangdao Jarujinda), a wealthy woman who adopted her. But because you never gave love and also oppressed to be inferior Makes Pitawan yearn for a perfect life.
title: Maya

overview: Kornpakamarasri, or Paka, is the daughter of Mr. Tinnakorn and Mrs. Saiyud, owners of Morakot Property Company, a famous real estate company. She had a nanny named Nim, who raised her to be a good person. After studying abroad, Paka came back home but didn't do any work because her family was rich. Later, her family's company started doing badly. Tinnakorn was stressed and working very hard. One day, he fell and died due to a blood vessel in his brain. Saiyud then let the subordinates help manage the work. As for herself, she became a gambling addict until she lost everything except for the company and some land. Tinnapan, a new millionaire, agrees to gamble with Saiyud because of her daughter's beauty. Saiyud lost and therefore had to transfer the company and the land to Tinnapan, but on the day of the transfer, he made an offer to marry Paka, and then he would return everything. Saiyud tries to persuade Paka to marry Tinnapan, but she refuses. Saiyud and Paka end up moving to a small, old, wooden house. Paka had a hard time adjusting and likes to look down on others, especially poor people. Meanwhile, Tinnapan always tries to help Paka without her knowing. Will his love eventually reach her heart?
title: Dok Fah Ya Jai

overview: Dance-A-Lot, a robot with rhythm, teaches preschoolers simple original dance steps.
title: Dance-A-Lot Robot

overview: The Honourable Woman tells the story of one woman's personal journey to right her father's wrongs. Featuring a stellar cast including Academy Award nominee Maggie Gyllenhaal in the lead role as Nessa Stein, this compelling drama written and directed by BAFTA winning Hugo Blick (The Shadow Line) draws Nessa into a complex and dangerous world of international conspiracy and espionage.
title: The Honourable Woman

overview: In Dominic Sandbrook: Let Us Entertain You, Dominic Sandbrook explores British post-war culture, arguing that it is a crucial part of Britain's modern identity - yet one firmly indebted to our Victorian past.
title: Dominic Sandbrook: Let Us Entertain You

overview: Programme for pre-school children combining animation with live action footage from National Geographic and the BBC film archives.
title: Mama Mirabelle's Home Movies

overview: For the Royal Family, Windsor Castle is simply home: a place to take time out and relax. But what actually goes on behind the castle walls? In this series Xand Van Tulleken, JJ Chalmers and Raksha Dave reveal decades of royal drama and uncover how the building itself has changed and adapted with the times.
title: Inside Windsor Castle

overview: Sue Perkins makes a triumphant return to Channel 5 with an incredible brand-new three-part series. Heading off the beaten track, Sue explores three regions of Thailand, meeting extraordinary people – and animals! First, she heads north to Chiang Mai, kicking off her journey by abseiling from the wonderfully named Crazy Horse Buttress into a limestone cave deep underground. Next, on the island of Phuket she helps to clear detritus from a coral reef: 'litter picking does not get any better than this!' In Bangkok she pops into a Buddhist Hell Garden to explore the potential wages of sin, has a driving lesson on an electric tuk-tuk in a monsoon and picks the world's most aromatic coconut with secateurs 20 feet above her head. Not scary at all. As she travels across Thailand she meets extraordinary animals too. Sue learns to sing lullabies to recovering elephants and discovers the secrets of a gibbon ‘love tunnel'. Throughout this vibrantly colourful and joyful meander through unseen Thailand, Sue Perkins is funny, fresh and empathetic, happily losing herself in Thailand.
title: Sue Perkins: Lost in Thailand

overview: Showcasing the beauty and charm of Cumbria, this new observational documentary series follows some of the hardy residents who live and work in this ceremonial county, exploring the magic of the Lake District National Park and delving into the beauty of its dramatic coastline. Filmed across Summer 2023, the series celebrates old traditions and welcomes new life, with unique access to historic castles and ancient gardens, as well as a range of characters from steamboat operators to wild swimmers, local potters to gin distillers, a lobster fishing couple to divers uncovering history from the bed of Lake Windermere.
title: Cumbria: The Lakes and the Coast

overview: The discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb became overshadowed by a Pharaoh's Curse. Now can modern science explain the truth behind this epic legend?
title: Tut's Toxic Tomb

overview: This drama series is about Maggie Mee, a woman who is left by her husband near her fortieth birthday. We see her begin her new single life by getting a job, getting new friends and even a new lover...
title: Life Begins

overview: Chef David Chang hosts an unfiltered dining experience as he cooks for celebrity guests and shares culinary secrets.
title: Dinner Time Live with David Chang

overview: Quarter Ton Teen follows teenagers struggling with severe obesity on a multi-year journey as they fight for healthier lives. Knowing they face uncertain futures unless they lose weight, these teens pursue weight-loss surgery in hopes of a second chance. Told in part with their own personal footage, the series documents their determination for a better life and the challenging journey to get healthy that will test them in ways they don't expect.
title: Quarter Ton Teen

overview: This is a real fight between those who feel the talent of a comedian, improvise well and dream of performing on stage. Instead of sharpened swords, there is wit, and instead of steel muscles, the participants use artistry. These fighters are not professionals yet, but they have the main thing - the desire to make the audience laugh and the thirst for victory.
title: Смех без правил

overview: A real comedy battle among the most desperate comedians. There is stand-up, improvisation and jokes on the edge and beyond.
title: Убойная лига

overview: They came for help, but became drug addicts. Children and young people tell about short routes to pills and syringes in Norwegian child welfare institutions.
title: Brennpunkt: Instukids

overview: News is discussed here because it is the most fertile environment for jokes. The participants of the comedy show, masters of improvisational humor, laugh only at current events that worry people and occupy the first lines in blogs. The topic of the program could be the launch of the hadron collider, the permission of cloning in Australia, or the election results in the United States.
title: Убойной ночи

overview: A humorous debate in which two teams defend their polar points of view on a certain topic. As a rule, current news or an event becomes the reason for discussion. The basis of the format is the classic panel comedy game, decorated with improvisations.
title: Убойный вечер

overview: Explores the story of The Second World War, beginning when the war become global and ending with the aftermath.
title: Hell on Earth: WWII

overview: Set in 1802, Smuggler is a fast-paced swashbuckler chronicles the adventures of ex-British naval officer turned smuggler Jack Vincent as he eludes revenue officers along the coast of England. A headstrong loner, Vincent frequently finds himself entangled in the espionage war between England and France in this early part of the Napoleon Era. Made by HTV West (Harlech Television, West) for the ITV Network.
title: Smuggler

overview: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer takes back the narrative of their lives by sharing disturbing yet empowering accounts of how they escaped the clutches of a serial killer.
title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer

overview: Renowned Mexican-American chef Aarón Sánchez travels to Los Angeles, Houston, Miami and New York to celebrate Latin restaurants with authentic flavors. On each episode, a celebrity guest joins him on this gastronomic adventure to cook up culture, share stories, and create a menu together.
title: Talking Sabor

overview: Ai Shiqi, a stay-at-home innkeeper who insists on being a "desert" woman, has become a "single typical" of the government crackdown after an outrageous legal battle. Thanks to Ezekiel, Genkan was forced to marry Ezekiel to help her get out of trouble. The "little couple," who thought they could split up after marriage, became embroiled in a leadership feud at the local tea house. Under the eaves of the family's house, there were strange rooms: Wei Junyi, an old grandmother who was Buddhist on the surface and a mirror on the inside. Luo Su-se, the fierce and ruthless mother of Jenkan, the self-possessed and spoiled sister of Jen Pearl, Lu Jiao, a maid whose vanity serves as a sword of mouth, Luo Aiji, an unworthy brother whose arrogance leaves no one behind, and Lin Dong-lin, a sleek and worldly husband-in-law. In the face of all kinds of difficulties, Ai Jie and the Scriptures exhausted their thoughts, and when he tried to give up several times, he found the meaning of "home" in the difficult scripture.
title: Hilarious Family 2

overview: Ballu is taken to a fairyland where he is blessed with special powers by six fairies, each having her own unique traits. He uses his powers to help good and honest children, including his friends.
title: Baalveer

overview: During the Republic of China, Du Lanruo, the daughter of a wealthy family in Yangcheng, suffered an accidental amnesia when she was young, resulting in a loss of identity. Later, he was adopted by Erhu artist Lao Ma, who changed his name to Ma Qingqing. He and his senior brother Shui Sheng, the three masters and apprentices shuttled around performing arts in teahouses and making a living as a waiter. Her only hobby is acting and she has amazing acting talent. Qingqing's biggest dream is to become a popular star like Du Lanruo.
title: Flower in the Mirror

overview: The Kashyaps like to believe they are an open-minded lot that respects everybody's work. But when their daughter falls in love with a cab driver, can they overcome their biases and accept her choice of partner?
title: Family Aaj Kal

overview: February 29, also known as Leap Day, comes around once every four years and is a cause for celebration. That is true for a lot of people, except for Day and Night. Every February 29, on their birthday, someone they love dies. But the year they turn 20, Day's cousin Ozone and Night's closest friend Dream survive the fateful curse. Day and Night must now work together to defeat their Leap Day destiny. Will this mystery be unraveled?
title: Leap Day

overview: When hitmen are in love, they put both their lives and hearts at risk. Now only one question needs to be answered: is it to kiss… or to kill? Kant, a badass tattooist police informant, is asked to investigate a hitman brother duo. But when his attempt to dig up information by getting close to the younger brother, Bison, gets curbed by the overprotective big brother Fadel, Kant has no choice but to find someone to take Fadel out of the way. That's where Style, his good-looking foolhardy mechanic friend, comes in. Now the two friends are putting their lives, and hearts, on the line.
title: The Heart Killers

overview: "You're like a sister to me. You're my best friend." Those were the words Baikhaw said to Tulip when they first met—before their worlds would forever change. What begins as a beautiful friendship between two young women unravels into a dangerous web of envy and deceit. Baikhaw hides her jealousy behind a perfect smile, aided by Tao, her devoted high-school friend who's long been in love with her and would do anything for her. On the other side, Tulip finds an alliance in Namo, her caring university friend who always stays by her side and protects her from Baikhaw's sinister schemes. But revenge rarely ends where it begins, and this game of betrayal might just destroy them all. Because sometimes, the most dangerous enemy… is your best friend.
title: Friendshit Forever

overview: Perfect 10 Liners is a group of perfect faces! Arm takes on the role of managing the Engineer Cute Boy page and unknowingly breaks the rules by posting a photo of his peer mentor's mentor Arc, also known as Perfect 10 Ferocious. Meanwhile, Gun has problems sleeping in the dark, but Perfect 10 Mysterious Yotha, Arm's peer mentee, volunteers to be his roommate. Lastly, Perfect 10 Piteous Wine is a peer mentee of Yotha who has no time to take care of him, so Yotha's younger brother Faifa steps in instead! How will the relationships and romances between the three Engineering student couples of the Perfect 10 Liners unfold?
title: Perfect 10 Liners

overview: Twenty-year-old Dokrak decides to take a gap year to find herself after finishing high school. She has a part-time job at a coffee shop in the gallery Art & Us. It's here that she crosses paths with twenty-two-year-old dentistry student Pam, who's a regular at the café, to hit the books. As she gets to know Pam, Dokrak develops a crush. When her brother, however, meets Pam, he falls for her at first sight. Kawi turns to Dokrak, asking her to play matchmaker. Because she loves him and wants to see him happy, Dokrak begins coaching him. As time goes on, however, she finds herself unable to ignore her growing feelings for Pam. Before she knows it, she's fully in love, and Pam is Kawi's girlfriend.
title: Us

overview: Chatfah, the youngest sister of the Buppajinda family, has just received the largest share of her father's inheritance and is about to be married. Unfortunately, however, Chatfah falls from the highest floor of a vacation home to her three older sisters' shocked eyes before her body disappears. Her three sisters—Baibua, Chomphu, and Picha—become suspects in her disappearance. The eldest sister Baibua is composed, wise, and has always sacrificed for her family. The second, Chomphu, is a confident model whose boyfriend Chatfah stole and was engaged to. The third, Putpichaya, is a jewellery designer and the closest to Chatfah. The three search for Chatfah while further tragedy befalls them following their youngest sister's disappearance. When no one else can be trusted, the three sisters must try to trust one another. They move back to their childhood mansion to find out who was behind Chatfah's disappearance, which could very well be one of them.
title: Hide & Sis

overview: Po has just been dumped by Earn, his boyfriend, because Po is not as successful as him. Po swore to himself that he would never meet someone like Earn again. However, working as a documentary director led him to meet Thame, the leader of the number one idol group MARS, who was about to leave his bandmates to succeed alone in Korea. The group had to disband, and Po branded Thame as no different from Earn. However, the more Po got to know Thame as a human being, and not an "idol," the more he realized that Thame was not the person he thought. Po wants to help Thame get his friends back, whether it's Nano, Jun, Dylan, or Pepper. Along the way to save MARS, Po accidentally falls in love with Thame, even though he knows that idols can't fall in love... and this feeling may be an obstacle for the group. But what if Thame also wants to love Po? If he doesn't care about those rules and loves Po, will the world collapse?
title: Thame - Po Heart That Skips a Beat

overview: After Boss and Jued go through love failures, Boss suggests Jued that she come to work at Break Up Service, a company that specializes in breaking up couples. Initially, they dislike each other, as they each played a role in the other's past breakups. However, as Jued proves her skills through hard work, Boss eventually acknowledges her competence. She begins to enjoy her job, relishing the role of a manipulator in relationships—destroying others' romances becomes her way of venting her frustration over her own failed love life. As they continue working together, Boss realizes he is falling for Jued. But Jued doesn't share his feelings. What will happen to their partnership and their mission to break up other couples?
title: Break Up Service

overview: Sant, a university student who has an unwavering love for sweets experiences the heartbreak of his life when he discovers he has a cavity! This forces him to seek treatment from Jay, a handsome dentist, who likes to act cool with a quirky personality. Starting as a tense, oil-and-water relationship, as Sant continues treatment, he begins to wonder whether Jay's caring nature is just part of the job or if there's something more beneath the surface.
title: Sweet Tooth, Good Dentist

overview: When the dice hits the ground, that's when the game begins. In this game, you have to fight. In this game, you must betray to survive. Because in this game… Your life is at stake. If you're ready to play the game, welcome to The Dark Dice.
title: The Dark Dice

overview: The Ex-Morning follows two former lovers whose romance ended on a bitter note as they are brought to work together as "exes." When Padtaphi, a top-tier reporter famously known as "Forecast Prince", loses his temper and throws hot coffee in the face of his junior reporter Tae, whom he doesn't get along with, Padtaphi is severely condemned by the public. His life turns upside down, going from rising star to fallen reporter, and his company immediately suspends Padtaphi and ends his role as a weather reporter to cool things down. Yong, a big producer who's Padtaphi's senior, gives him a chance to develop a fresh news program on the condition that he must work with a new producer, Tamtawan, who holds a degree from abroad and turns out to be Padtaphi's ex! The two of them face many obstacles while working on the show together, from earning the trust of the crew that hates Padtaphi, to capturing the public's affection, and most importantly, winning each other's hearts. Can old flames reignite? Will this return to working together change them, or will they learn from this change together?
title: The Ex-Morning

overview: Nabun, a struggling hair stylist, flees to Chiang Mai after losing her job and discovering her boyfriend's betrayal. While at a hot spring, she nearly drowns and is mysteriously saved. When she awakens, she finds herself in the body of Princess Laila, a sickly noblewoman in the ancient Lanna Kingdom. Adapting to her new life, Nabun faces the challenges of survival and love, encountering kind Chao Saen Thep, her sister's fiancé, and the stern Chao Mueang Fah. Her unconventional thoughts captivate those around her, bringing a fresh perspective to the kingdom's old ways.
title: Scarlet Heart Thailand

overview: When a new client comes into James Busby's hair salon, all he knows is their name, never their story. As each powerful episode unfolds, we join him on a gripping journey of discovery as he cuts to the crime. Featuring hairdresser and host James Busby, well-known for his transformative online hairdressing content, contributors arrive at his salon and sit in the chair, just like in any hairdressers. While they have their hair washed, cut, dried, and styled, James nurtures them through a powerful, revealing and personally rewarding chat that allows them to share their story and the impact on them, their friends, their family and the wider public too. Each contributor opens up to James in an honest chat that's unfiltered, to the point, real and emotional.
title: Cut to the Crime

overview: Step back in time and immerse yourself in history like never before with Bill Whittle. Get ready to experience the pivotal moments that molded America in a whole new way. With captivating historical footage, you'll feel like you're right there in the thick of it all– without the woke filter. Don't just read about history. Live it.
title: What We Saw

overview: In the game show that started in the Netherlands and has already conquered many countries around the world, 49 players enter the country's largest LED game board at the beginning of each week, but only 1 can remain by the end of the week.
title: The Floor - Csak egy maradhat

overview: One of the UK's first rock/pop music shows, was a must watch for teenagers on a Friday evening. Often featured The Beatles, The Rolling Stones and The Who.
title: Ready Steady Go!

overview: The cheeky glove puppet fox hosts a variety and sketch show format - a procession of comic stooges play straight man and second fiddle to his antics.
title: The Basil Brush Show

overview: Celebrity guests answer tricky and sometimes provocative questions from the hosts.
title: Ху из Ху

overview: Ireland's finest musicians perform at the most beautiful and iconic places on the island.
title: Ireland in Music

overview: Witness the incredible work behind the scenes in Irish museums as we meet the custodians who devote their craft to preserving Ireland's Hidden Treasures.
title: Ireland's Hidden Treasures

overview: Tia and Tamera Mowry play twins who were separated at birth and by chance meet each other in a shopping mall. Ray Campbell, Tamera's adopted father, is very different from Tia's adopted mother, Lisa Landry, but the twins don't want to be separated so Ray and Lisa end up living together. The series often focuses on the trouble the twins get into due to their identical appearance and the love-hate relationship between Lisa and Ray.
title: Sister, Sister

overview: Four-part series that follows two novice kayakers, as they undertake an epic journey along the northern coast of Ireland.
title: Kayak Ó Thuaidh

overview: Pass It On follows the journeys of three football clubs competing in the top tier of women's football in Ireland throughout the 2023 season.
title: Pass It On

overview: The "Fashionable vs Folk" project is based on a long-standing confrontation between two respected and beloved popular presenters - People's Artist Nadezhda Babkina and the famous Russian fashion expert Vladislav Lisovets. The heroes of the program find themselves in a studio, where they listen to accusations about their appearance from their friends or relatives, after which they first fall into the hands of "folk" stylists Nadezhda Babkina, and then to "fashionable" stylists Vladislav Lisovets.
title: Модный vs Народный

overview: The project "10 Years Younger" has been successfully running in England since 2004. Today, analogues of the show can be seen in many countries - from New Zealand to the United States of America. Thousands of women around the world have been able to change themselves thanks to this program. Finally, Russian women also have the opportunity to become participants in a grandiose project.
title: На 10 лет моложе

overview: Series following the work of a dedicated squad of care-staff at Ireland's oldest and largest animal welfare charity, the DSPCA.
title: The Shelter: Animal SOS

overview: Fallen Idols: Nick and Aaron Carter delves into the lives of Nick and Aaron Carter. From their outsized fame in the late 1990s and early 2000s to their headline-making struggles in recent years, the docuseries pulls back the curtain on the fraught dynamic of the Carter family and the dark side of such an abrupt rise to fame. At its core, Fallen Idols explores the accusations of sexual assault against Nick Carter by three women, while also diving into his brother, Aaron Carter's, struggles with mental health and substance abuse - and the rift that occurred after Aaron decided to support his brother's accusers.
title: Fallen Idols: Nick and Aaron Carter

overview: Shen Zhuoran, a retired literature professor, lives a seemingly content life with his children and grandchildren. After the passing of his beloved wife, he embarks on a journey of matchmaking, encouraged by an old friend. Along the way, he meets four very different women: a kind-hearted head nurse who parts ways with him over a property dispute, a scientist who vanishes after her cancer returns, a domineering union director who smothers him emotionally, and a woman who resembles his late wife but makes a difficult request. Each encounter brings Shen Zhuoran not just emotional challenges but also personal growth. His reflections on love and life ripple through the family, quietly shaping those who have stood by his side all along.
title: Love Again

overview: Post the deadly Pulwama attacks, Kashyap and his team strike back with a fitting reply. In the age of hybrid warfare, they must race against time to bring back their captured pilot while also battling Pakistan's lies in global media.
title: Ranneeti: Balakot & Beyond
